Low-level PropertyBag/OPropertyContainerHelper qualify nonvirtual calls for real native Any input/output members. Four actual generated property-set SDK declarations retain exact methods, sorted/unique-name contracts, original direct bases and normal CPPU metadata. Real native sequence and PropertyChangeEvent member tests preserve moves, Type view replacement, default/conversion and actual ActiveDataSink query identity.
